definitions.week: ISO week of the start date, UTC
definitions.conv_clean: contestants per impression on campaigns with no repeatable action and 14 days or less
definitions.live_over: start on or before the holiday date and end on or after it; the comparison group is drawn from campaigns not spanning it with the same duration mix
definitions.holiday dates: 2026 dates used to place holidays in weeks; live-over uses each campaign's own year
definitions.by_close_day_type: close_type from the organizer's own country and Nager.Date public holidays: an end date that is a public holiday in that country counts as holiday even if it also falls on a weekend; the rest split weekday against weekend. Stratified by run-length band because holiday closes cluster in December, which also carries longer advent-style runs
definitions.last_days_impression_curve_by_duration: median share of a campaign's impressions landing on each day before the end (0 is the final day, the mirror of impression_curve_by_duration in prize_timing_cuts.json which is anchored to the start)
definitions.seasonal_crowding: weeks split into the busiest and quietest quarter by share of starts (by campaign count, not by a duration-matched sample), campaigns pooled within each group and again within the three largest industries
definitions.per_day_by_length_industry: contestants and entries-per-entrant scaled by the run's own length, so a 30-day campaign is compared to a 7-day one on a daily rate rather than a cumulative total
definitions.per_day_by_type: campaign type from the same title and description wording used in campaign_types.json, contestants per day of the run
